instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the NO CART / NO CHECKOUT / NO PRICING requirement. This is an international luxury architectural catalogue.
Make sure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, filters, admin actions) has a clear `data-testid` attribute.
Header must NEVER be 100% transparent: use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0C0E]/85 border-b border-white/10` to guarantee high readability over large images.
Support both mobile and desktop responsiveness flawlessly with generous spacing (py-20, py-28) on section breaks.
Keep company contact numbers readily clickable: `tel:8088791219`, `https://wa.me/918088791219?text=Hello%20Lalu%20Clading...`, and `mailto:laluclading45@gmail.com`.
The Admin panel at `/admin` must be complete, easy to navigate, with persistent local/mock API data state allowing full CRUD for products, categories, projects, slides, and brochure links.
